Name: Hidden Spring Farm Cave
Author: neuralwiles
Description:
Replaces the farm cave! Adds crop space, mine cart access, optional casking, and a secret hot spring area.


[size=4][i]Features[/i][/size]

  ♡  Larger farm cave map with extra functionality:
  ♡  ﻿Crop space which can grow crops regardless of season.
  ♡  ﻿Fishing area where you can catch algae and (rarely) cave jelly.
  ♡  Mine cart access.
  ♡  ﻿Optional toggle to allow casking (disabled by default).
  ♡  A secret hot spring accessible via a hidden doorway behind the waterfall!
